experiment: E3b imperfect physics (FSDT) + higher-fidelity labels (TSDT) at matched capacity

rules.target_model: Reddy TSDT (fgplate.tsdt), same designs, loads and split as pilot_200
rules.metric: per-design relative L2 over all five scaled generalized fields vs TSDT (primary); w-only reported
rules.selection: tail-aware: minimize max(validation median / 1%, validation p95 / 3%); ties by median. Replaces the median-first rule of E3a, whose hybrid tails grew with labels.
rules.target: validation median <= 1.0% and p95 <= 3.0% (mean over seeds)
rules.Q1: bias correction: at N = 10, 20, 40, arm X (Hy or Hc) corrects the physics bias if the 95% bootstrap interval of the median per-design paired difference (P error - X error, seed-averaged, 30 validation designs) lies above 0
rules.Q2: label efficiency under model-form error: same test with (D error - X error) at N = 10, 20, 40
rules.Q3: smallest label budget meeting the target, per arm
